scenario.name: Blackwell manufacturing with supplier-resolved HBM draws
scenario.notes: Illustrative integration that replaces the aggregate HBM wafer branch once and preserves every upstream HBM capacity draw. Logic, packaging, supplier capacity, yield, qualification, allocation, and demand inputs remain synthetic.

manufacturing_scenario.scope: The frozen Blackwell logic and advanced-package scenario, with its aggregate HBM wafer flow removed before reconciliation.

hbm_supplier_result.scope: The frozen supplier portfolio's Blackwell-qualified and customer-allocated HBM3E stacks across three non-overlapping declared capacity scopes, including every underlying capacity draw.

mapping.confirming_evidence: The hash-pinned capacity-draw artifact reproduces the supplier result's aggregate and per-supplier distributions and conserves every stack-to-package conversion.
mapping.falsifying_evidence: A source correction changes supplier scope, topology, qualification, allocation, the customer-allocated stack distribution, or any pinned capacity-draw byte.
mapping.notes: A deterministic permutation preserves the full HBM marginal and within-draw supplier allocation without asserting an unsupported draw-index relationship to logic or packaging.
